detail.body:
Disk-delta sync can report success while leaving the model's indexed weights unchanged when a checkpoint directory contains unreferenced safetensors files with duplicate tensor names. Both the trainer's baseline reader and the engine's local checkpoint writer scan every safetensors file, so a stale file visited last can override the indexed tensor location. The sender and receiver can agree on that stale file, pass checksum verification, and still leave the weights used for model reload untouched.

Read the shard list from `model.safetensors.index.json` when present, matching the model loader's indexed-file selection. Apply this to the trainer and both SGLang patch bundles. Missing indexed shards fail instead of falling back to stale files; unindexed checkpoints retain the existing behavior.

### Validation

- Added 13 CPU regression cases covering indexed selection, missing shards, unindexed checkpoints, and actual pull/apply round trips for both encodings and both patch bundles. The tests execute the receiver module extracted from each shipped patch.
- On baseline `8c17b676`: **10 failed, 3 passed**. With this change: **13 passed**.
- Additional local H20 probe: four GPUs tested independently × two encodings × two patch bundles. All 16 cases failed before and passed after; each passing case applies three successive BF16 SGD updates and checks reloaded weights and forward outputs with zero tolerance. This is a checkpoint/transport integration probe, not a full SGLang serving or RL run.
- Black, isort, Ruff, `git diff --check`, and `git apply --check` for the modified standalone receiver module in both bundles passed.

Reproduce the committed regression suite with:

```bash
python -m pytest tests/test_disk_delta_checkpoint_index.py -q
```

Prepared with Codex assistance; validation results above were observed on the actual before/after implementations.

+"""Disk delta must update the same checkpoint shards the model loader reads."""
+
+import importlib.util
+import json
+from pathlib import Path
+from types import ModuleType
+
+import numpy as np
+import pytest
+import safetensors.numpy
+import zstandard
+
+NUM_GPUS = 0
+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
+PATCHES = sorted((ROOT / "docker" / "patch").glob("*/sglang-pull_weights.patch"))
+
+
+def _load_trainer():
+    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("disk_delta", ROOT / "slime/utils/disk_delta.py")
+    module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
+    spec.loader.exec_module(module)
+    return module
+
+
+def _load_receiver(patch):
+    # Test the exact standalone module shipped to SGLang in each patch bundle.
+    text = patch.read_text()
+    section = text.split("+++ b/python/sglang/srt/weight_sync/local_checkpoint.py\n", 1)[1]
+    section = section.split("\ndiff --git ", 1)[0]
+    source = "\n".join(line[1:] for line in section.splitlines() if line.startswith("+"))
+    module = ModuleType("local_checkpoint")
+    exec(compile(source, str(patch), "exec"), module.__dict__)
+    return module
+
+
+def _write_checkpoint(path):
+    path.mkdir()
+    safetensors.numpy.save_file({"weight": np.ones((2, 2), dtype=np.float32)}, path / "model.safetensors")
+    safetensors.numpy.save_file({"weight": np.zeros((2, 2), dtype=np.float32)}, path / "stale.safetensors")
+    (path / "model.safetensors.index.json").write_text(json.dumps({"weight_map": {"weight": "model.safetensors"}}))
+
+
+@pytest.fixture(params=[None, *PATCHES], ids=["trainer", *(p.parent.name for p in PATCHES)])
+def reader(request, monkeypatch):
+    module = _load_trainer() if request.param is None else _load_receiver(request.param)
+    # scandir/glob order is unspecified; force the stale file to be visited last.
+    original_glob = module.glob.glob
+    monkeypatch.setattr(module.glob, "glob", lambda pattern: sorted(original_glob(pattern)))
+    return module
+
+
+def test_index_excludes_stale_shards(reader, tmp_path):
+    checkpoint = tmp_path / "checkpoint"
+    _write_checkpoint(checkpoint)
+    locations = reader._tensor_locations(str(checkpoint))
+    assert Path(locations["weight"][0]).name == "model.safetensors"
+
+
+def test_missing_indexed_shard_does_not_fall_back_to_stale_weights(reader, tmp_path):
+    checkpoint = tmp_path / "checkpoint"
+    _write_checkpoint(checkpoint)
+    (checkpoint / "model.safetensors").unlink()
+    with pytest.raises(FileNotFoundError):
+        reader._tensor_locations(str(checkpoint))
+
+
+def test_unindexed_checkpoint_remains_supported(reader, tmp_path):
+    safetensors.numpy.save_file({"weight": np.ones(4, dtype=np.float32)}, tmp_path / "model.safetensors")
+    assert set(reader._tensor_locations(str(tmp_path))) == {"weight"}
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("patch", PATCHES, ids=[p.parent.name for p in PATCHES])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("encoding", ["xor", "overwrite"])
+def test_delta_updates_indexed_weights(patch, encoding, tmp_path, monkeypatch):
+    trainer, receiver = _load_trainer(), _load_receiver(patch)
+    original_glob = trainer.glob.glob
+    monkeypatch.setattr(trainer.glob, "glob", lambda pattern: sorted(original_glob(pattern)))
+    base, local, stream = tmp_path / "base", tmp_path / "local", tmp_path / "stream"
+    _write_checkpoint(base)
+    stream.mkdir()
+    receiver.pull(str(local), str(base), str(stream), 0)
+    read = trainer.make_tensor_reader(str(base))
+    old = read("weight")
+    new = np.full((2, 2), 2, dtype=np.float32).view(np.uint8).reshape(-1)
+    diff = new ^ old if encoding == "xor" else trainer.overwrite_encode(new, new != old)
+    version = stream / "weight_v000001"
+    version.mkdir()
+    compressed = np.frombuffer(zstandard.ZstdCompressor().compress(diff), dtype=np.uint8)
+    safetensors.numpy.save_file(
+        {"weight": compressed}, version / "model.safetensors", metadata={"weight": trainer.checksum("adler32", new)}
+    )
+    (version / "model.safetensors.index.json").write_text(
+        json.dumps(
+            {
+                "metadata": {
+                    "version": "000001",
+                    "base_version": "000000",
+                    "delta_encoding": encoding,
+                    "compression_format": "zstd",
+                    "checksum_format": "adler32",
+                },
+                "weight_map": {"weight": "model.safetensors"},
+            }
+        )
+    )
+    receiver.pull(str(local), str(base), str(stream), 1)
+    # The delta's own checksum can pass while the indexed model stays stale.
+    loaded = safetensors.numpy.load_file(local / "model.safetensors")["weight"]
+    np.testing.assert_array_equal(loaded.view(np.uint8).reshape(-1), new)
+    np.testing.assert_array_equal(safetensors.numpy.load_file(local / "stale.safetensors")["weight"], 0)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    raise SystemExit(pytest.main([__file__]))

issue_comments.body:
The two failing jobs in this PR's CI also fail on its exact parent commit, `main@8c17b676cb57af1d17ee4402e91e9209af84b60b`. The [main-branch run from October 2](https://github.com/THUDM/slime/actions/runs/37003384102) predates this PR and contains the same failures:

- **`test_top_p_validation_checks_shared_support_in_chunks`**: expected four top-p support reads, but observed `[]` at `tests/test_score_centering_transport.py:525`. [Baseline job](https://github.com/THUDM/slime/actions/runs/37003384102/job/110825959472) / [this PR's job](https://github.com/THUDM/slime/actions/runs/37187496424/job/111392462859).
- **`test_dynamic_filter_drops_groups_and_refills`**: `group_lease()` imports `straw.protocol.Lease` on the no-lease path, raising `ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'straw'` at `slime/data/transport.py:179`. [Baseline job](https://github.com/THUDM/slime/actions/runs/37003384102/job/110825959560) / [this PR's job](https://github.com/THUDM/slime/actions/runs/37187496424/job/111392463018).

Those tests, their affected implementation files, and the CI workflow are unchanged by this PR. #2436 addresses these regressions separately. This PR remains scoped to checkpoint shard selection for disk-delta sync.

The 13 new disk-delta regression cases passed in the Linux container, and the separate BF16 H20 probe passed all 16 configurations. These are local validation results; the new test file is not in the existing always-on CPU CI matrix. The pre-commit check also passed.

Thanks for taking a look.
